sources.title: Modern Robotics Mechanics Planning and Control
sources.titleEn: Modern Robotics Mechanics Planning and Control
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 柔性夾爪與軟體機器人
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每爪與總力沒有二倍誤差，摩擦值標為教學假設，重心與動態仍列為未驗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Avoid a factor-of-two force error, label μ as assumed, and retain center-of-mass/dynamic checks.
related.difference: 比較幾何尺寸對柔順度的影響，辨認小變形梁與大變形軟體機器人的差距。
related.differenceEn: Compare geometric effects on compliance and distinguish small-deflection beams from large-deformation soft robots.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 垂直靜態搬運簡化為2μN≥Smg，N是每爪法向力；動態、接觸壓力與力矩另驗。 教學質量1 kg、μ=0.30、比較係數S=2、g=9.81 m/s²。 每爪N≥2×1×9.81/(2×0.30)=32.7 N；兩爪法向力總和65.4 N。
矩形懸臂I=bt³/12，端點小撓度δ=FL³/(3EI)；此Euler–Bernoulli細長梁近似忽略剪變形，算例L/t=6的限制須記錄。L以三次方、t以負三次方影響撓度。 合成E=10 N/mm²、b=10 mm、t=5 mm、L=30 mm、F=0.2 N。 I=104.1667 mm⁴；δ=0.2×30³/(3×10×104.1667)=1.728 mm，δ/L=5.76%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A simplified vertical static grasp requires 2 μN≥Smg, with N per jaw; dynamics, pressure and moments need separate checks. Teaching mass 1 kg,μ0.30, comparison factor S 2, g 9.81 m/s². Each jaw needsN≥32.7 N; the sum of normal forces is 65.4 N.

For a rectangular cantilever I=bt³/12 and small tip deflection δ=FL³/(3 EI). This Euler–Bernoulli slender-beam approximation omits shear deformation, a limitation at this example’s L/t=6; length and thickness enter cubically. Synthetic E 10 N/mm², b 10 mm, t 5 mm, L 30 mm, F 0.2 N. I=104.1667 mm⁴;δ=1.728 mm and δ/L=5.76%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 工廠輸送線節拍平衡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每爪與總力沒有二倍誤差，摩擦值標為教學假設，重心與動態仍列為未驗。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Avoid a factor-of-two force error, label μ as assumed, and retain center-of-mass/dynamic checks.
related.difference: 區分客戶需求節拍與各站週期，找出平均時間會掩蓋的瓶頸。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish demand takt from station cycle time and expose bottlenecks hidden by averages.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 垂直靜態搬運簡化為2μN≥Smg，N是每爪法向力；動態、接觸壓力與力矩另驗。 教學質量1 kg、μ=0.30、比較係數S=2、g=9.81 m/s²。 每爪N≥2×1×9.81/(2×0.30)=32.7 N；兩爪法向力總和65.4 N。
需求節拍=可用時間/需求量；無緩衝停機的理想串線吞吐由最慢站決定。 教學班次有效25200 s，需求420件，三站週期35、55、65 s。 需求節拍60 s；瓶頸65 s，理想班產25200/65=387.692件，完整件最多387件。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A simplified vertical static grasp requires 2 μN≥Smg, with N per jaw; dynamics, pressure and moments need separate checks. Teaching mass 1 kg,μ0.30, comparison factor S 2, g 9.81 m/s². Each jaw needsN≥32.7 N; the sum of normal forces is 65.4 N.

Takt=available time/demand; an ideal serial line without downtime is limited by its slowest station. Teaching productive shift 25200 s, demand 420 units, station cycles 35,55,65 s. Takt 60 s; bottleneck 65 s gives 387.692 theoretical units/shift, at most 387 completed whole units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
